newsitem.title: ALBANIA: One killed in Tirana royalist rally shooting.
newsitem.headline: One killed in Tirana royalist rally shooting.

text.p: One man was killed and another injured on Thursday when shooting broke out during a march by Albanian monarchists in central Tirana, the state prosecutor's office said.
"The victim was killed by a bullet in the chest while the other person, aged about 25, was injured," Albanian news agency ATA reported, quoting a statement from the prosecutor's office.
The prosecutor's office said the injured man had been struck by a bullet cartridge that flew out of a firearm being fired nearby.

"Police are investigating the incident between monarchist supporters and police near the central electoral commission," the statement said. An armoured personnel carrier had been positioned outside the commission headquarters and the number of guards there increased, it added.

Monarchists are disputing the partial results of a referendum on Sunday which showed that voters had rejected the idea of restoring the monarchy. The ballot was held on the same day as a general election which early results indicate the Socialists have won.

Self-proclaimed king, Leka, son of Albania's last king, Zog, was bundled into a car when shooting erupted after he led a march of some 500 supporters down Tirana's main boulevard from the main Skanderbeg Square.
